title: Registry collection entry
description: One file per collection under collections/<ns>/<name>.json. A pointer to a git-hosted Bruno/OpenCollection, plus display metadata.

ref.description: Fallback git ref to install when no release/version is selected (default branch, e.g. "main"). Versioned installs resolve to a release TAG, not this; ref is the unversioned/track-the-branch target for collections that don't cut releases.

tagPrefix.description: Identifies this collection's release tags when several collections share one repo (e.g. "stripe-stripe-api@"). Defaults to "<subdir>@" when a subdir is set, else whole-repo. The version shown is the tag with this prefix stripped.
